comment: Golden redaction vectors. Python (gradientharbor.privacy) and Swift (HarborKit Redactor) must produce exactly these outputs. Each case uses a fresh Redactor seeded with `known`; cases within one group share a Redactor so placeholder numbering carries over.

cases.input: Hi, I'm Owen Novak (BM-10200, policy POL-55000). Where's my claim CLM-88013? Call me at (408) 555-0100.
cases.expected: Hi, I'm [NAME_1] ([MEMBER_ID_1], policy [POLICY_ID_1]). Where's my claim [CLAIM_ID_1]? Call me at [PHONE_1].

cases.input: I need to file a claim, it was $1,250.00 for my visit on 2026-11-02. Email owen.novak@example.com
cases.expected: I need to file a claim, it was [AMOUNT_1] for my visit on 2026-11-02. Email [EMAIL_1]

cases.input: My DOB is 1971-03-25 and I live at 7283 Gull Ct, San Jose, CA 95112. Novak is my last name; owen is my first.
cases.expected: My DOB is [DOB_1] and I live at [ADDRESS_1]. [NAME_2] is my last name; [NAME_3] is my first.
